_note: The 3 MITRE ATT&CK techniques the attacker can use. Ids and names come from attack.mitre.org. The plain-English descriptions are written for beginners and are used by explain.py later.

T1078.name: Valid Accounts
T1078.description: The attacker logs in with a real account or password that already works on the next machine.

T1190.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
T1190.description: The attacker breaks into a program that is open to the internet, such as a public website.

T1210.name: Exploitation of Remote Services
T1210.description: The attacker uses a known flaw in a service on another machine to get into it over the network.
